text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган has managed to leave
quite a
mark on the Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And then... Maya and Trainer live
together all
lovey-dovey! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Happily ever after! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Come on, you two, get your heads out
of the
clouds.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Hey. Don't be a killjoy, Hishiama!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: You're calling me a killjoy? Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't keep her waiting. Hurry
up.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'll head out first. Make sure you're not
late!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
It looks like everyone has already fallen
in love
with me.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I guess I've got no choice but to
head out,
huh? I mean, it's for their
sake! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thanks for waiting! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: ...Who would wait for you?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! You're the one who suggested
partner
running after school!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Now I'm angry, Brian! You'll be eating
my fumes!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Heheh! There's nothing I can't do!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Awaiting orders! I'll do whatever
you say,
so lay it on me!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: Twinkle as bright as you can!

text_block_list.text: Copy that! ☆ Hehe, to the sky!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: It's time for takeoff! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
